title: Bitwise AND of Numbers Range
summary: Return the bitwise AND of every integer from left through right, including both endpoints.

contractDetails.constraints: 0 ≤ left ≤ right ≤ 2147483647. Values and result are nonnegative signed 32-bit integers.
contractDetails.output-checking: Exact typed equality of the returned int.

statement: Return the bitwise AND of every integer from left through right, including both endpoints.

examples.explanation: The leading 1100 bits survive the changing low bits.
The high bits match, and the last bit clears.

constraints: 0 ≤ left ≤ right ≤ 2147483647. Values and result are nonnegative signed 32-bit integers.
hints: Conceptual: A bit survives only if every value in the range contains it.
Directional: Find the common binary prefix of the endpoints.
Implementation: Shift both endpoints right until they agree, then restore the removed positions as zeros.
complexityAnalysis: O(w) time and O(1) auxiliary space for bit width w.
